top_signals.title: Bridgewater China Cut Gold and Is ‘Optimistic’ on Local Stocks
top_signals.summary: Bridgewater Associates’ China arm told investors it has turned less bullish on gold and is “prudently optimistic” on local stocks, shifting some of its views after a wild quarter as the fund gives human managers more control over allocations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Markets face twin threats of surging crude prices and concern over durability of AI boom
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Blockchain Association pushes for crypto tax clarity as broader bill stalls
top_signals.summary: As progress stalls on a crypto bill, the Blockchain Association is urging Congress to pass legislation to resolve uncertainty around taxes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: SK Hynix abandons plan for US unit's IPO, citing market volatility
U.S. refineries have been running at very high rates in 2026
top_signals.summary: The U.S. refinery fleet has run at higher-than-normal rates this year, with refinery utilization averaging more than 95% of capacity between May and September, the highest for those months since 1998. Tight global product supplies this year have boosted margins for petroleum products, particularly for diesel, incentivizing the increased run rates.
